failure_analysis.root_cause: Java ProcessBuilder process-reaper wait-status ownership conflicts with Frida ptrace of the same direct child. Java exitValue8390015 is a nonterminal ptrace stop status, not a valid child exit. Native-parent launch removes that competing Java child reaper from the hooked PID and passes with the identical runtime, native producer and listener.

source.operation: Java_java_lang_ProcessHandleImpl_waitForProcessExit0 calls waitpid(pid,&status,0), returns WEXITSTATUS or signal status for terminal events, otherwise returns raw status.

failure_analysis.attribution_limit: No instruction-level native wait trace was added. Actual returned Java stop status, source operation and native-parent differential establish the launch/reaper conflict; no unsupported conclusion about blanket sandbox/ptrace inability or native hook failure.
failure_analysis.production_implication: Keep workload status ownership in the maintained native supervisor/process-tree layer, rather than attaching a directly ProcessBuilder-reaped workload. Diagnostic C native parent is not proposed as a new production dependency.
